## Objetivo
Document the completed application's execution, tests, persistence and product rules in the root README. Add automated documentation assertions to the existing fast Node test suite. Describe the approved Docker environment without changing it. Do not create, modify or commit a runtime database file. T09 owns the visual-review checklist; T12 owns container persistence verification. This task documents those deliverables only.

## Critérios de Aceitação
- [ ] README.md exists and tests/unit/readme.test.ts uses the existing Node test runner to assert the presence of npm run dev, npm test, npm test && npm run test:e2e, npm ci --no-audit --no-fund and http://localhost:4173. Document Docker with Compose as the host prerequisite (no host Node requirement), group bootstrap/invite flow, local time display, attendee snapshot rule, recent-night filtering, explicit ties and optional scores. Assert these topics in README content. Assert the literal Markdown link `[Visual review checklist](docs/visual-review.md)` by reading README only, not the link target. npm test remains green and includes these documentation assertions.
- [ ] README.md documents the configured default SQLite location, DB_PATH override, persistence across container restarts, backup guidance with the app stopped and successful tests returning exit 0. Include T12's exact host-only persistence verification command as documentation text, describing its isolated mounted test database, actual container restart, no host port, cleanup and text diagnostics location. Explain that internal fast/full commands do not invoke Docker and close/reopen tests alone are not container evidence. tests/unit/readme.test.ts verifies the command string and these topics by reading README.md only, using expected literal text from the T12 contract. It must not read, execute, create or modify the referenced script, test databases or diagnostic files. Those are not T07 deliverables. No runtime database is accessed, created, modified or committed by this task.
- [ ] README gives exact host commands: export NANTS_WORKTREE="$PWD" before building; docker compose -f .nants/compose.yaml build workspace; docker compose -f .nants/compose.yaml run --rm workspace sh -lc 'npm ci --no-audit --no-fund'; docker compose -f .nants/compose.yaml run --rm --service-ports workspace sh -lc 'npm run dev'; docker compose -f .nants/compose.yaml run --rm workspace sh -lc 'npm test'; and docker compose -f .nants/compose.yaml run --rm workspace sh -lc 'npm test && npm run test:e2e'. Explain stopping and rerunning the app preserves mounted data, while test databases are temporary. Include equivalent workspace commands for npm run typecheck and npm run build. Automated README assertions verify the export and all these commands. No Docker configuration changes are required.
- [ ] (manual) README describes a short phone check: vote yes/maybe/no, confirm duration, select multiple participants/winners and enter/omit scores, checking comfortable touch targets and no clipped controls. This check is optional and does not block acceptance.
